document:1:573:0.text:
<style="stress">Kraff's Will</style>
To whom it may concern,

Unfortunately, I suffered a <style="highlight">high-tier arcane backlash</style> during an experiment, leaving my body severely corrupted. Pursuant to Article 3, Chapter 7 of the Magical Safety Regulations, my remains must be placed in a <style="highlight">triple-layered sealed coffin</style> to prevent the corruption from spreading to others.

Warning: Do not open the coffin or perform any purification rituals under any circumstances. Ignore this warning at your own peril.

Please ensure the personal belongings on my desk remain in their original state and are handed over to my next of kin.

Lastly, if you wish to pay your respects, please bring a bottle of golden amber wine and a slice of mille-feuille cake to my grave. Hopefully, they can... soothe my restless spirit.

May Dura grant me forgiveness.

<align="right"><style="stress">Janne Kraff</style>
document:1:573:0.source_cn:
<style="stress">克拉夫特关于葬礼及事务处理的紧急遗嘱</style>
致各位：
本人因在实验中不幸触发<style="highlight">高阶以太分解反应</style>，身体已遭到严重的虚空侵蚀。根据魔法安全条例第7章第3条，为防止虚空扩大波及他人，请在我去世后务必使用<style="highlight">三层特制封印棺椁</style>将我收殓。
切记：严禁任何形式的开棺和净化仪式，否则后果自负！
关于我工位上的私人物品，请务必保持原状，交由我的亲属保管处理。
最后，若念及旧情，请带一瓶金琥珀葡萄酒及巴克千层蛋糕置于我的墓前，好让这些能……安抚我躁动的亡魂。
愿艾雅宽恕。
<align="right"><style="stress">——让内·克拉夫特</style>

say:2:1711149402:0.text: After sharing its contents with the court mages, they quickly begin pointing out inconsistencies of their own.
say:2:1711149402:0.source_cn: 你将遗嘱上的内容转达给了宫廷魔法师们，他们也各自发现了疑点。
say:2:1711149402:0.male: After sharing its contents with the court mages, they quickly begin pointing out inconsistencies of their own.
say:2:1711149402:0.female: After sharing its contents with the court mages, they quickly begin pointing out inconsistencies of their own.

say:4:1711149403:1.text: Several things here don't add up...
say:4:1711149403:1.source_cn: 这遗嘱在逻辑和时态上有些说不通……

say:5:1711149404:1.text: A high-tier arcane backlash would be extremely violent. The victim would lose the ability to move within seconds.
say:5:1711149404:1.source_cn: 高阶以太分解反应是非常剧烈的，中咒者几秒钟内就会失去行...

say:6:1711149405:1.text: But he supposedly had enough time to write a whole will while on the brink of death, and even cite Article 3, Chapter 7 of the Magical Safety Regulations.
say:6:1711149405:1.source_cn: 他在“身体遭到严重侵蚀”的濒死状态下，还能条理清晰地引...

say:8:1711149406:1.text: And he even requested to have mille-feuille cake and golden amber wine placed before his grave. That wine is a limited edition and super hard to come by!
say:8:1711149406:1.source_cn: 而且他还特别叮嘱要在墓前放巴克千层蛋糕和金琥珀葡萄酒。...

say:9:1711149407:1.text: Wait! Cake? Wine? I knew something felt off!
say:9:1711149407:1.source_cn: 等等！蛋糕！葡萄酒！我刚才就觉得哪里不对劲！

say:10:1711149408:1.text: I passed by his grave a while back and that place was completely spotless. No dust at all. And there was a freshly discarded cake box right in front of it!
say:10:1711149408:1.source_cn: 我后来有一次路过那里，发现他的墓碑一尘不染，连一点杂草...

say:11:1711149409:1.text: It's as if someone was visiting every day to maintain it, and eating the offerings!
say:11:1711149409:1.source_cn: 就好像……每天都有人去精心维护和“进食”一样！

say:13:1711149410:1.text: You piece together every suspicious detail surrounding Kraff's death.
say:13:1711149410:1.source_cn: 你将关于克拉夫特“死亡”的疑点在脑海中全部列出……
say:13:1711149410:1.male: You piece together every suspicious detail surrounding Kraff's death.
say:13:1711149410:1.female: You piece together every suspicious detail surrounding Kraff's death.
